Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 27-Dec-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE MAKEUP EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2025  
  Data Structures and Algorithms [ECE_4447]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                        Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Differentiate between Program and Algorithm. Discuss the specifications of an algorithm.                 (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                       Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           Differentiate between Space complexity and Time complexity.                                              (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Represent and discuss the significance of Sparse matrix transpose.                                       (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Illustrate the conversion of Infix to Postfix operation by taking any arithmetic expression.             (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                        Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Differentiate between Stacks and Queues.                                                                 (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)           With an example code, explain the insertion operation at the end for a Singly linked list.               (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                Enlist the terminologies used in Binary tree with an example.                                            (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                           Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           With example, explain Inorder Traversal method used in Binary tree.                                      (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Expand the terminologies used in AVL tree with proper definitions.                                       (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4)                With an illustration, explain the adjacency list to represent graphs.                                    (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                        Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  
  Page #1

B)                Suggest an algorithm for Linear search considering both Best case and Worst case complexities.         (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)                Discuss the steps of Merge sort algorithm.                                                             (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5)                        Suggest an algorithm for Merge sort highlighting the significance of the same.                         (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                             Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                Discuss the steps involved in heap sort.                                                               (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  C)                Discuss the necessity of Breadth First Search algorithm.                                               (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"
